portal_synopsis: CloudForms Cloud Engine 1.0.1 bug fix update
portal_solution:
Before applying this update, make sure that all previously-released errata
relevant to your system have been applied.

This update is available via Red Hat Network. Details on how to use the Red Hat
Network to apply this update are available at
https://access.redhat.com/knowledge/articles/11258
allTitle: (RHBA-2012:1063) CloudForms Cloud Engine 1.0.1 bug fix update
title: (RHBA-2012:1063) CloudForms Cloud Engine 1.0.1 bug fix update
portal_summary:
Updated CloudForms System Engine packages that fix various bugs are now
available.
portal_product_filter: Red Hat Enterprise Linux|Red Hat Enterprise Linux Server|5|x86_64
Red Hat Enterprise Linux|Red Hat Enterprise Linux Server|5|i386
portal_description:
Red Hat CloudForms is an on-premise hybrid cloud Infrastructure-as-a-Service
(IaaS) product that lets you create and manage private and public clouds. It
provides self-service computing resources to users in a managed, governed, and
secure way.

This update fixes bugs in Cloud Engine packages and upgrades the system to
CloudForms 1.0.1.

After updating these new packages, please run the following script to update the
database schema:

 # /usr/share/aeolus-conductor/script/upgrade

To view the full list of changes, click on the following link:
http://docs.redhat.com/docs/en-US/CloudForms/1.0/html/Technical_Notes/sect-Technical_Notes-Cloud_Engine-RHBA-2012_13263-01.html

Users are advised to upgrade to these updated CloudForms Cloud Engine packages,
which resolve these issues.
